CheckTitle: Disabled onPremisesObjectIdentifier update bypass enforces hard-match security protections
Description: On hybrid tenants the tenant-level feature flag allowOnPremUpdateOfOnPremisesObjectIdentifierEnabled must be false. When enabled it bypasses the hard-match security protections that prevent an on-premises sync engine from taking over a cloud account that already has onPremisesObjectIdentifier set or holds a privileged Entra role.
Risk: An attacker with write access to on-premises Active Directory can craft an object whose sourceAnchor or immutableId matches a privileged cloud account. With the bypass enabled, the sync engine overwrites the cloud identity, granting the attacker full control of that account and any roles it holds.

Code.Other:
No Entra admin center UI exists for this flag. Use Microsoft Graph PowerShell:
1. Connect-MgGraph -Scopes "OnPremDirectorySynchronization.ReadWrite.All"
2. $OnPremSync = Get-MgDirectoryOnPremiseSynchronization
3. $OnPremSync.Features.AllowOnPremUpdateOfOnPremisesObjectIdentifierEnabled = $false
4. Update-MgDirectoryOnPremiseSynchronization -OnPremisesDirectorySynchronizationId $OnPremSync.Id -Features $OnPremSync.Features

Before disabling, finish remediating affected objects (clear onPremisesObjectIdentifier to null where intended, temporarily remove privileged roles during a planned hard match).

Recommendation.Text: Disable allowOnPremUpdateOfOnPremisesObjectIdentifierEnabled once migration or recovery work is complete. The bypass is a temporary measure that weakens hard-match protections enforced since July 2026.

Notes: This check only applies to hybrid tenants with on-premises directory synchronization enabled. Cloud-only tenants receive a PASS since the attack path does not exist. The msgraph-sdk may not model the property natively; the service layer falls back to features.additional_data to parse it.
